The XRD pattern of the pre-mixed powder at 0 h reveals the diffraction peaks related to the individual elements Fe, Mn, Ni, Al, Si and C; many diffraction peaks of the alloying elements co-exist at almost the same d-spacing.

source.reason: At 0 h (pre-mixed powder) the XRD reveals only the diffraction peaks of the individual constituent elements with no alloyed phases, so the structure is the starting elemental blend.

unmapped_findings: Nominal composition of the pre-mixed powder (0 h): Fe40Mn19Ni15Al15Si10C1 (at.%) corresponding to Fe-46.00%, Mn-21.50%, Ni-18.13%, Al-8.34%, Si-5.78%, C-0.25% (wt.%). [b0020]
The starting elemental Fe, Ni, Mn, Al, Si and C powders were 99.2% pure. [b0020]

The XRD pattern of the pre-milled (pre-mixed) powder and standard peaks of the elements Fe, Mn, Ni, Al and Si are shown in Supplementary Fig. S1 (a & b); many diffraction peaks of the alloying elements co-exist at almost the same d-spacing. [b0039]

In the pre-mixed powder at 0 h, the diffraction peak intensity of all the elements is highest and these elemental peaks decrease/vanished with milling time; low-intensity peaks of all elements vanished after 5 h of milling and the intensity of Al diminished after 15 h, indicating the highest alloying rate for Al. [b0034, b0038]

Particle size and morphology of the elemental powder blend (0 h) are not explicitly quantified in the text; the first SEM micrograph reported (Fig. 2(a)) corresponds to 10 h milled powder, not to the 0 h pre-mixed state.
